Kallisto alignment result: 

```{r}
kallisto_alignment_summary <- read.csv('~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/multiqc/kallisto_alignment_summary.csv')

kallisto_alignment_summary$n_not_aligned <- kallisto_alignment_summary$n_processed - kallisto_alignment_summary$n_pseudoaligned

data_long <- kallisto_alignment_summary %>%
  select(Sample = sample_ID, Pseudoaligned = n_pseudoaligned, NotAligned = n_not_aligned) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Pseudoaligned, NotAligned), names_to = "AlignmentStatus", values_to = "Count")

ggplot(data_long, aes(x=Sample, y=Count, fill = AlignmentStatus)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pseudoaligned" = "steelblue", "NotAligned" = "darkred")) +

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7)) +
  labs(title = "Kallisto: Alignment Scores for added dataset (Ecr)",
       x = data_long$Sample,
       y = "Number of aligned Reads",
```

Loading count data (saved via tximport on cluster):

```{r count tables}
counts_geneID <- read.csv('~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/count_tables/counts_genelev_corrected.csv', row.names = 1)
duplicates <- c("ERR7738945.1", "ERR7738946.1", "ERR7738947.1")
counts_geneID <- counts_geneID[,!names(counts_geneID) %in% duplicates] # genelevels

counts_genelev_tpm <- read.csv('~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/count_tables/counts_tpm_abundance2.csv', row.names = 1)
counts_genelev_tpm <- counts_genelev_tpm[,!names(counts_genelev_tpm) %in% duplicates] # genelevel tpm

counts_lengthscaledTPM <- read.csv('~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/count_tables/counts_lengthscaledTPM.csv', row.names = 1) # counts scaled with lenghtscaledTPM

gene_counts_stegmann <- read.csv('~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/count_tables/RNAseq.gene.counts.kallisto.txt',sep="\t", row.names = 1)
tpm_counts_stegmann <- read.csv('~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/count_tables/RNAseq.gene.abundance.kallisto.txt',sep="\t", row.names = 1)
```

```{r}
# keep only Col0 samples of dataset
stegmann_samples_to_keep <- c("1_5_S4","1_9_S8","2_9_S21","2_13_S25","3_1_S29","3_9_S30","4_1_S31","4_5_S35","4_9_S39","4_13_S43","5_1_S47","5_5_S51","5_9_S55","5_13_S59","6_1_S63","6_5_S67","6_13_S74")

# remove X at the beginning of the sample names
colnames(gene_counts_stegmann) <- gsub('X','',colnames(gene_counts_stegmann))
colnames(tpm_counts_stegmann) <- gsub('X','',colnames(tpm_counts_stegmann))

gene_counts_stegmann <- gene_counts_stegmann[, names(gene_counts_stegmann) %in% stegmann_samples_to_keep]
tpm_counts_stegmann <- tpm_counts_stegmann[, names(tpm_counts_stegmann) %in% stegmann_samples_to_keep]
```


```{r}
# set gene ids as separate column
gene_counts_stegmann <- gene_counts_stegmann %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id")
counts_geneID <- counts_geneID %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id")

tpm_counts_stegmann <- tpm_counts_stegmann %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id")
counts_genelev_tpm <- counts_genelev_tpm %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id")

counts_geneID$gene_id <- gsub("\\.1$", "", counts_geneID$gene_id)
counts_genelev_tpm$gene_id <- gsub("\\.1$", "", counts_genelev_tpm$gene_id)

# combine to count tables
gene_counts <- full_join(counts_geneID,gene_counts_stegmann, by="gene_id")
tpm_counts <-  full_join(counts_genelev_tpm,tpm_counts_stegmann, by="gene_id")

# Replace NA values with 0 (since missing genes should be treated as 0 counts)
gene_counts[is.na(gene_counts)] <- 0
tpm_counts[is.na(tpm_counts)] <- 0

# set genes back as rownames
gene_counts <- gene_counts %>% tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "gene_id")
tpm_counts <- tpm_counts %>% tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "gene_id")
```


Loading meta data:

```{r}
metaData <- read.csv("~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/data/metaData_2.0.csv", sep=";")
metaData$Timepoint_dpi <- metaData$Timepoint..dpi.

# create pathogen column
metaData$pathogen <- ifelse(metaData$Experiment == "Heterodera schachtii 2", "Heterodera schachtii", metaData$Experiment)
metaData$pathogen <- ifelse(metaData$Experiment == "Hyaloperonospora arabidopsidis 3", "Hyaloperonospora arabidopsidis", metaData$pathogen)
metaData$pathogen <- ifelse(metaData$Experiment == "Hyaloperonospora arabidopsidis 2", "Hyaloperonospora arabidopsidis", metaData$pathogen)
metaData$pathogen <- ifelse(metaData$Experiment == "Plasmodiophora brassicae 2", "Plasmodiophora brassicae", metaData$pathogen)
metaData$pathogen <- ifelse(metaData$Experiment == "Turnip mosaic virus (TuMV) 3", "Turnip mosaic virus (TuMV)", metaData$pathogen)

# get pathogen abbreviations
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Heterodera schachtii", "H. schachtii", metaData$pathogen)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Alternaria brassicae", "A. brassicae", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Botrytis cinerea", "B. cinerea", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Cauliflower mosaic virus (CaMV)", "CaMV", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Turnip mosaic virus (TuMV)", "TuMV", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Turnip yellows virus (TuYV)", "TuYV", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Turnip yellows virus (TuYV)", "TuYV", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Golovinomyces orontii", "G. orontii", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Erysiphe cichoracearum ", "E. cichoracearum", metaData$pathogen_abbr) 	
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Hyaloperonospora arabidopsidis", "Hpa", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Meloidogyne javanica", "M. javanica", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Plasmodiophora brassicae", "P. brassicae", metaData$pathogen_abbr)
metaData$pathogen_abbr <- ifelse(metaData$pathogen == "Erisyphe cruciferarum", "E. cruciferarum", metaData$pathogen_abbr)

# column with infected pathogens (take all control samples together)
metaData$inf_path <- ifelse(metaData$infected_control == "infected", metaData$pathogen_abbr, "control")

# coumn with infected pathogens in category
metaData$Category <- ifelse(metaData$infected_control == "infected", metaData$Category, "control")
metaData$Category_trophs <- ifelse(metaData$infected_control == "infected", metaData$Category_trophs, "control")

# get library size in the metadata
kallisto_alignment_results <- read.csv('~/Studium/bachelor-thesis-luisa/multiqc/kallisto_alignment_summary.csv')
metaData <- merge(metaData, kallisto_alignment_results, by.x = "Run", by.y = "sample_ID", all.x = TRUE)
colnames(metaData) <- ifelse(colnames(metaData) == "n_pseudoaligned", "LibrarySize", colnames(metaData))
metaData <- metaData[order(metaData$ID),]

# create binary meta data for correlation calculations
metaData_bin <- binarizeCategoricalColumns(metaData, convertColumns = c("inf_path", "infected_control", "Timepoint_dpi", "Library", "Category", "Category_trophs"), includePairwise = FALSE, includeLevelVsAll = TRUE, minCount = 1, dropFirstLevelVsAll = FALSE)
colnames(metaData_bin) <- gsub(".vs.all", "", colnames(metaData_bin))

# remove CaMV category (unsure)
metaData_bin <- metaData_bin[,-35]
```

Filter low expressed genes (with tpm values (genelevel tpm)): 

Result: 
- before filtering: 27598 genes
- after filtering: 25175 genes

if tiniest dataset with contrast is 3 samples, then
--> keep genes that have at least 0.5 TPM per sample in at least 3 samples.

```{r}
smallest_tpm <- 0.5
percentage <- 0.51
num_samples <- ncol(tpm_counts)
# genes to keep
keep <- rowSums(tpm_counts >= smallest_tpm) >= 3

gene_counts_filtered <- gene_counts[keep,]
```

PCA function:

```{r pca function}
perform_pca <- function(count){
   #log_count_matrix <- log2(count + 1)
  # perform PCA
  pca_result <- prcomp(t(count))
  return (pca_result)
}

visualize_standard_pca <- function(data, pca_result, ellipse, title, PC3){
  if(ellipse == TRUE){
    if(PC3 == TRUE){
      ggplot(data, aes(x = PC3, y = PC4, color = Experiment)) +
      geom_point() +
      stat_ellipse(aes(color = Experiment), type = "norm") +
      xlab(paste0("PC3: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 3], 2), "% variance")) +
      ylab(paste0("PC4: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 4], 2), "% variance")) +
      ggtitle(title) +
      theme_minimal()
    }
    else{
    ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Experiment)) +
      geom_point() +
      stat_ellipse(aes(color = Experiment), type = "norm") +
      xlab(paste0("PC1: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1], 2), "% variance")) +
      ylab(paste0("PC2: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 2], 2), "% variance")) +
      ggtitle(title) +
      theme_minimal()
      }
  }
  
  else{
    if(PC3 == TRUE){
      ggplot(data, aes(x = PC3, y = PC4, color = Experiment)) +
      geom_point() +
      xlab(paste0("PC3: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 3], 2), "% variance")) +
      ylab(paste0("PC4: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 4], 2), "% variance")) +
      ggtitle(title) +
      theme_minimal()
    }
    else{
      ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Experiment)) +
        geom_point() +
        xlab(paste0("PC1: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1], 2), "% variance")) +
        ylab(paste0("PC2: ", round(100 * summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 2], 2), "% variance")) +
        ggtitle(title) +
        theme_minimal()
      }
  }
}
```

PCA on raw (and filtered) vst counts:  
  
```{r pca}
# vst counts filtered with tpm value
pca <- perform_pca(assay(vsd))
pca_data <- data.frame(Sample = rownames(pca$x),
                       PC1 = pca$x[, 1], 
                       PC2 = pca$x[, 2], 
                       PC3 = pca$x[, 3], 
                       PC4 = pca$x[, 4]) %>% merge(metaData, by.x = "Sample", by.y = "Run")

pca_data$infected_control <- as.character(pca_data$infected_control)
```


PCA on unfiltered vs filtered counts

```{r pca}
# PC1 and PC2
visualize_standard_pca(pca_data,pca, TRUE,"PCA of filtered vst counts", FALSE)
ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Experiment, shape=infected_control)) +
        geom_point() +
        #stat_ellipse(aes(color = Category), type = "norm")+
        xlab(paste0("PC1: ", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1], 2), "% variance")) +
        ylab(paste0("PC2: ", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 2], 2), "% variance")) +
        ggtitle("PCA of filtered vst counts") +
        theme_minimal()
      

# PC3 and PC4
visualize_standard_pca(pca_data,pca, FALSE,"PCA of filtered vst counts", TRUE)

```

```{r}
# Identifying outlier samples
sampleTree0 <- hclust(dist(input_mat0), method = "average") #Clustering samples based on distance 


#Plotting the cluster dendrogram
options(repr.plot.width = 20, repr.plot.height = 10)
#Setting the graphical parameters
par(cex = 0.6);
par(mar = c(0,4,2,0))
plot(sampleTree0, main = "Sample clustering to detect outliers", sub="", xlab="", cex.lab = 1.5,
cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2)
abline(h=300, col ="red")
```

Three outliers were found that should be removed --> choose a cut height of 300 to keep the rest of the samples

```{r}
clust = cutreeStatic(sampleTree, cutHeight = 300, minSize = 10)
table(clust)

# clust 1 contains the samples we want to keep.
keepSamples = (clust==1)
input_mat = input_mat0[keepSamples, ]
nGenes = ncol(input_mat)
nSamples = nrow(input_mat)

# adjust meta data to filtered input matrix
metaSamples = rownames(input_mat)
traitRows = match(metaSamples, metaData$Run)
metaData = metaData[traitRows, ]
metaData_bin = metaData_bin[traitRows, ]

# Identifying outlier samples
sampleTree <- hclust(dist(input_mat), method = "average") #Clustering samples based on distance 


#Plotting the cluster dendrogram
options(repr.plot.width = 20, repr.plot.height = 10)
#Setting the graphical parameters
par(cex = 0.6);
par(mar = c(0,4,2,0))
plot(sampleTree, main = "Sample clustering to detect outliers", sub="", xlab="", cex.lab = 1.5,
cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2)
```
